questions.question: A person sold a pen drive for Rs. 1,674 and incurred a loss of 7 %. At what price (in Rs.) should it be sold to earn a profit of 11%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of the pen drive = Rs. 1674

Loss % = 7

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price + cost price × profit%

Selling price = Cost price - cost price × loss%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the pen drive be 100a

According to the question,

100a - 100a × 7% = 1674

⇒ 93a = 1674

⇒ a = 1674/93

⇒ a = 18

So, cost price = 100 × 18

⇒ Rs. 1800

Now,

Selling price to get a profit of 11% = 1800 + 1800 × 11%

⇒ 1998

**∴ It should be sold at 1998 (in Rs.) to earn a profit of 11%.**

questions.question: IF the eight-digit number 9534x37y is divisible by 24, then what is the value of (3x + y), for the largest value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

9534x37y is divisible by 24

**Concept used:**

Divisibility Rule of 8 = If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, then the number is completely divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 3 = If the sum of digits of the number is divisible by 3, then the number itself is divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

24 = 8 × 3

So, the number should be divisible by both 8 and 3

37y is divisible by 8

Only possible value of y = 6

Now,

9 + 5 + 3 + 4 + x + 3 + 7 + 6 = 37 + x

Possible values of x = 2, 5, 8 

According to the question,

x = 8

Now,

(3x + y) = 3 × 8 + 6

⇒ 30

**∴ Requried answer is 30.**

questions.question: The income of X is 15% less than that of Y and the income of Z is 60% less than the combined income of X and Y. By what percent is the income of Z less than the income of X? (Correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The income of X is 15% less than that of Y

The income of Z is 60% less than the combined income of X and Y

**Calculation:**

Let the income of Y be 100a

So, income of X = 100a × 85%

⇒ 85a

Now,

Income of Z = (100a + 85a) × 40%

⇒ 185a × 40%

⇒ 74a

Difference of income of X and Z = 85a - 74a

⇒ 11a

Required % = (11a/85a) × 100

⇒ 12.94 ≈ 12.9%

**∴ The income of Z is 12.9% less than the income of X.**

questions.question: Find the value of { sqrt{4p³+14p+6} } such that a 6-digit number 602p0p is divisible by 9.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

602p0p is divisible by 9

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 9 = If the sum of digits of the number is divisible by 9, then the number itself is divisible by 9.

**Calculation:**

6 + 0 + 2 + p + 0 + p = 8 + 2p

Now,

8 + 2p should be divisible by 9

For p = 5

8 + 2p = 8 + 2 × 5 = 18 which is divisible by 9

So, p = 5

Now,

{ sqrt{4p³+14p+6} } = { sqrt{4 times 5³+14 ×5+6} }

⇒ { sqrt{4 times 125+70+6} }

⇒ { sqrt{500+70+6} }

⇒ { sqrt{576} }

⇒ 24

**∴ Required answer is 24.**

A certain sum of money becomes 5 times in 15 years when invested at simple interest. In how much time (years and months) will is becomes 12 times itself at the same rate at simple interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum of money becomes 5 times in 15 years when invested at simple interest. 

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

S.I = Amount - P

Here,

P = Sum or principal

T = time

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be P and rate be R

Here,

Amount = 5P

So, interest = 5P - P = 4P

Now,

4P = (P × 15 × R)/100

⇒ 4P × 100 = 15PR

⇒ R = 400P/15P

⇒ R = 80/3

Again,

To become 12 time of P

Interest would be 11P

Now,

Let the time for P to be 12 times of it be T

11P = (P × T × 80)/(3 × 100)

⇒ 11P × 300 = 80PT

⇒ T = 3300P/80P

⇒ T = 41.25

Now,

41.25 years = 41 years and 3 months

**∴ Required time is 41 years 3 months.**

questions.question: The breadth of a rectangular field is 7.5 m shorter than its length. One-third of the breadth is equal to one-fourth of the length of the rectangle, What is the average (in m, to the nearest integer) of its length and breadth?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The breadth of a rectangular field is 7.5 m shorter than its length. 

One-third of the breadth is equal to one-fourth of the length of the rectangle

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

1/3 of breadth = 1/4 of the length

⇒ (Breadth)/(Length) =(frac{1)/(4)}{(1)/(3)} 

⇒ (Breadth)/(Length) =(3)/(4) 

Let the length and breadth be 3x and 4x

Now,

4x - 3x = 7.5 m

⇒ x = 7.5 m

So, length = 4 × 7.5 = 30 m

breadth = 3 × 7.5 = 22.5 m

Total of length and breadth = 30 + 22.5

⇒ 52.5

Average = 52.5/2

⇒ 26.25 ≈ 26 m

**∴ The average (in m, to the nearest integer) of its length and breadth is 26.**

questions.question: A 280 m long train is running at a speed of 54 km/h. In how much time (in seconds) will it cross a man moving at 12 km/h in the same direction as that of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train = 280 m

Speed of the train = 54 km/h

Speed of the man = 12 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is computed by their difference.

If a train cross a man/pole/tree then it will cover only its own length.

**Calculation:**

Relative speed of the train and the man = (54 - 12) = 42 km/h

Speed in m/sec = 42 × (5/18)

⇒ 35/3 m/sec

Time = 280 ÷ (35/3)

⇒ 280 × (3/35)

⇒ 24 sec

**∴ It will cross the man in 24 seconds.**

questions.question: In a class of 60 students (boys and girls), there are 60 % girls. In an examination, the average score of the boys is 52 and that of the girls is 65. What is the average score of the whole class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 60

Average score of the boys = 52

Average score of the girls = 65

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/number of elements

**Calculation:**

Number of girls = 60 × 60%

⇒ 36

Number of boys = 60 - 36 = 24

Now,

Total score of the boys = 24 × 52

⇒ 1248

Total score of the girls = 36 × 65

⇒ 2340

Total score of the total students = 1248 + 2340

⇒ 3588

Average = 3588/60

⇒ 59.8

**∴ The average score of the whole class is 59.8.**

questions.question: In a 1000 km trip, a man drives at a speed of 50 km/h for the first five-eighth of the total distance. If he completes the whole journey in 19 hours (resting time not included), what is his speed (in km/h, correct up to 1 decimal place) for the rest of the journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 1000 km

Speed for 5/8th of the distance = 50 km/h

Total time taken = 19 hours

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/time

**Calculation:**

five-eighth of 1000 = 1000 × (5/8)

⇒ 625 km

Remaining distance = 1000 - 625

⇒ 375

Time taken to cover 625 km = 625/50

⇒ 12.5 hours

Remaining time = 19 - 12.5

⇒ 6.5 hours

Speed of the remaining distance = 375/6.5

⇒ 57.69 ≈ 57.7 km/h

**∴ His speed (in km/h, correct up to 1 decimal place) for the rest of the journey was 57.7.**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 8,192 in 3{ {1} over 2} years and to Rs. 9,472 in 6 years, at simple interest at a certain rate per cent p. a. The rate of interest p.a. and the sum are _____ and _____, respectively.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs. 8,192 in 3{ {1} over 2} years and to Rs. 9,472 in 6 years

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Here,

P = sum

T = time

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Interest for (6 - 3{ {1} over 2}) = 2{ {1} over 2} years = 9472 - 8192

⇒ 1280

So, interest for 1 year = 1280 ÷ 2{ {1} over 2}

⇒ 1280 × { {2} over 5}

⇒ Rs. 512

Interest in 6 years = 512 × 6

⇒ Rs. 3072

So, sum = 9472 - 3072

⇒ Rs. 6400

Now,

Let rate of interest be R

So,

512 = (6400 × R × 1)/100

⇒ 64R = 512

⇒ R = 512/64

⇒ R = 8

So, rate = 8%

**∴ The rate of interest p.a. and the sum are 8% and Rs. 6400, respectively.**
